author: Scott Manley
description:
Last month I spent a few hours talking with scientists at Science Systems and Applications Inc. about their work, both their internal projects within SSAI and their support for NASA projects and the broader Moon to Mars Architecture. 

We talk about exploring the moon using spacecraft that were designed to study the earth. Evidence for water on the moon and proposals to study the flows of water around the surface. Space weather hazards. Asteroid impacts and impacting asteroids and why Mars needs a weather forecast if we're really going to explore it.

Interviewees:
Oreste Reale - Chief Corporate Scientist
Ryan Ihnacik
Nick Gorkavyi
Guiallme Gronoff
Gal Sarid


Sponsored by SSAI
